purpose: Actual pure-contact grasp of loaded cart and CONTINUOUS ALTERNATING BACKWARD STEPS. Empty scenes, a bite alone, local neck pulls and20mm body-back are not the requested delivery.

budget.offline_gait_helper: /root/cart_collision_handoff <=10min,0steps,2threads/2GiB within aggregate budget; bounded FK/IK/static screening only

frozen_inputs.payload: Real unbound20kg 600x400x150mm full box with original full inertia and true deck initial placement; not a tiny object with mass replaced

scene: Goose+complete cart+visible cargo+ground in ONE real scene. Robot root, cart root and cargo root truly free. Original3 internal mechanical equalities only; no torso/foot locks, robot-object bindings, suction, online state writes or applied external/root forces.

experimental_fixture.scope: Uncalibrated passive mechanical/cart-resistance assumptions inherited from006, not a qualified spring SKU, actual sustained8N force or physical hardware redesign. Record actual reactions and rod trajectory.

original_drive: Only18 joint targets via original immutable adapter:200Hz drive/physics,50Hz commands,original slew/gains/22.2V torque-speed derating/350W positive mechanical design budget/disabled peaks. Original MCI/axes/limits/closed-loop/filter and mu assumptions preserved.
direct_response_to_user: 007 remains three failed unloaded trials, retained as history. Its strict empty qualification is not reclassified as pass. PM authorizes a separate loaded diagnostic to observe actual object behavior; do not keep hiding requested car behind perfect empty tests.
staged_execution: At most ONE initial preposed true cold clamp+20mm loaded body-back to verify scene, contact transfer and logging. This is setup evidence only, not completion or the final headline video.

Main stage must execute repeated alternating foot support/backward placement with actual free-root mechanics while maintaining true clamp and moving the loaded cart. Use bounded offline gait helper output or justified Teacher feedback, no PPO or inherited failed Move policy as a success baseline.
Add finite active approach/open-close when feasible using genuine rod-defined TCP and all non-target contacts checked. A cold pregrip scene must be labelled; it does not prove autonomous acquisition.
A single problem gets at most two targeted corrections before PM receives evidence and chooses an alternative. Do not spend the whole budget polishing gait plans, contact classifiers or archives.

primary_acceptance.meaning: Only measured object+body displacement and repeated actual feet motion support this goal; requested trajectories and neck motion do not. Formal reliability/maximum load/thermal rating remain separate.

controls: TCP desired path anchored at cold actual rod then moves backward with planned body/cart transport, with sensible measured contact feedback. Do not unconditionally chase stationary actual rod to extend neck and cancel traction. No live state writes. Actual feet/root movement only from dynamics. New controller/provider is separately identified; original frozen sources remain.
diagnostic_vs_acceptance: Original5mm material slip per intended stance and contact quality limits remain qualification metrics. Record when they fail, never reset or relabel them. As declared exploratory loaded evidence, a failed metric may continue within explicit gross safety envelope to observe why grip/transport fails. Whole-run cumulative material speed is not a permanent point net displacement; per-stance versus swing recorded separately.
hard_abort: NaN/warnings or drive breach;tilt>25deg or fall/unsupported body ground hit;unexplained significant initial penetration>.5mm;unintended shell/shaft contact as main transport mechanism;gross stance slip>20mm per foot per planted phase;object binding/state overwrite. Record collisions/closure/soft penetration even below stop. The TCP error>5mm for200ms implementation gap from007 must be explicitly implemented or predeclared measured diagnostic rather than silently omitted.
evidence: Prestate-aligned all robot/cart/cargo poses, foot support/swing/placement, per-contact6D forces and native pad/rod versus shell/shaft, grip loss, cart/cargo/root displacement and velocity, footprint/slip/CoP, actual torques/speeds/caps/power, true wheel reactions/tongue load, constraint/penetration/warnings, exact input identities, resources. Compare commanded and realized movement.
video: Continuous original-speed bright physics replay with one camera showing goose mouth on actual rod, whole loaded cart/box, both feet and ground throughout; also a useful mouth/rod close view if cheap. Main delivery MUST have the real cart/cargo; never an empty diagnostic as drag result. No generated image, teleport or composited fake interaction.
reporting: Report first actual loaded contact/transport attempt promptly to PM, not after long archiving. Give actual continuous-walking success/failure, true distances, grip/feet/actuator cause evidence. If no0.5m, state NOT ACHIEVED and show the failure sequence. No claim maximum load or real-world/cross-engine qualification.
exit: Return by the hard deadline with actual car-containing evidence and precise remaining blocker. No hidden long training, scheduled task or automatic budget renewal.
